remarks: Whispering Pond where life style is everything. Enjoy Bruce Park, live in a sanctuary year round. Uniquely designed to have a single family home feel. This home features over 4600+sq/ft of living space with an open floor plan, perfect for entertaining. French oak hardwood floors throughout, an eat-in gourmet high-end Porcelanosa kitchen with family room that has built in custom cabinetry and coffered ceiling. Three spacious nicely appointed bedrooms with ensuite Porcelanosa bathrooms on the 2nd floor. The oversized roof top deck has unobstructed views of the water in Bruce Park. Lower level media room can also be used as an optional 4th bedroom.This home is wired for whole house audio and is a smart-home. Two car garage. Close to train/shops.
